name: Everything Spice" Baked Tofu Rice Bowl with Avocado, Tomatoes & Dill

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a small saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup jasmine rice
1 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, place seeds and spices in a small bowl; stir to combine the "everything spice" mixture. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp sesame seeds
1 tsp poppy seeds
½ tsp onion powder
¼ tsp garlic powder
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place mayo and Dijon in another small bowl. Stir to combine the Dijon mayo.
Cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels, then return tofu to one half of the baking sheet. Season both sides with salt.

Spread half of the Dijon mayo over the top side of the tofu, then sprinkle with half of the spice mixture (pressing gently to adhere). Carefully flip tofu and repeat with remaining Dijon mayo and spice mixture. (Reserve spice bowl for later use.)
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 pint grape tomatoes
1 lemon
½ small bunch fresh dill
½ avocado

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes to the other half of the baking sheet with the tofu. Drizzle with oil and season with salt. Stir to coat and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring tomatoes halfway through, until tofu is golden and tomatoes are blistered in spots, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, zest and juice lemon into the reserved bowl.
Shave dill leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Add to the bowl with the lemon along with oil, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅛ tsp salt
⅛ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Halve and pit avocado; slice thinly while still in the skin, then scoop out with a spoon.
To serve, divide rice between bowls. Top with tofu, roasted tomatoes, avocado, and capers, then drizzle with dressing. Enjoy!
